sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Compare these two examples. Find the step where they stop being the same.

items.prompt: A line has equation y = 2x - 1. Which of these equations represents a line parallel to it?

steps: Parallel lines have the same slope but different y-intercepts.
y = 2x + 4 has slope 2, the same as y = 2x - 1, but a different intercept.
So y = 2x + 4 is parallel to the given line.

items.prompt: A line has equation y = 2x + 1. Write the equation of the line through (3, 4) that is parallel to this line.

steps: A parallel line has the same slope, 2.
Use y = 2x + b and the point (3, 4): 4 = 2(3) + b.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A plant's height is given by H = 4w + 8, where H is the height in centimeters and w is the number of weeks since it was measured. What does the slope represent in this context?
choices: The plant was 8 centimeters tall when it was first measured.
The plant grows 8 centimeters per week.
The plant grows 4 centimeters per week.
The plant was 4 centimeters tall when it was first measured.

items.prompt: A moving company's total cost is given by C = 13h + 6, where C is the total cost in dollars and h is the number of hours of labor. What does the y-intercept represent in this context?
choices: The company charges $13 for each additional hour of labor.
The company charges a flat fee of $6 before any labor hours.
The company charges $6 for each additional hour of labor.
The company charges a flat fee of $13 before any labor hours.

items.prompt: Find the slope of the line through (-12, 13) and (-14, 8).

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt:
A line passes through these points:
x: -3, -1, 1, 3
y: 14, 19, 24, 29
What is the slope (rate of change) of the line?

A line passes through (-6, 12). A slope triangle on the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 5 and a vertical leg (rise) of 2. A similar slope triangle further along the same line is 4 times as large. Which point also lies on the line?
A line has a slope of 1/9. A right triangle drawn along the line has a vertical leg (rise) of 59 units. What is the length of the other leg?
Write the equation, in slope-intercept form, of a line with slope 7 and y-intercept -10.

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: Identify the slope and y-intercept of the line y = (-5/2)x - 5.
choices: slope = -5, y-intercept = -5/2
slope = -5/2, y-intercept = -5
slope = 5/2, y-intercept = -5
slope = -5/2, y-intercept = 5

items.prompt:
Relationship A: y = (11/6)x
Relationship B (proportional):
x: 1, 2, 3
y: 1, 2, 3
Which relationship has the greater rate of change (unit rate)?
choices: Relationship B
Relationship A
The rate of change cannot be determined from this information.
They have the same rate of change.
